title: Dejarik With the Wookiee
description: Aboard the Millennium Falcon, Poe Dameron and Finn team up to try and defeat Chewbacca at another game of Dejarik. When the pair jokingly accuse the Wookiee of cheating, Chewbacca's famous temper flares up. Just then, the hyperspace alert sounds from the cockpit, and Chewbacca leaps up to tend to it. Rather than lose again, Poe and Finn simply shut the game off.
